subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Cedar Pharma
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@cedarpharma.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@cedarpharma.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Hi Anika + Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and lots of alignment on the use case (drug formulation search + internal R&D knowledge retrieval). Quick recap and a few asks so we keep momentum: 

What we covered:
- High-level use case: ingesting internal docs + public literature for fast retrieval and LLM-augmented summaries for R&D teams.
- Success criteria: sub-2s median latency for lookup flow, <5% hallucination rate on benchmark prompts, and 30% TCO reduction vs current self-hosted setup.
- Timeline: evaluation with security/procurement during Nov–Dec, target decision by end of Q1 2027.

Asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map — can you share the org chart or a quick list of the primary stakeholders across: economic buyer, security, legal, procurement, and the R&D product owner? I attached a one-page template that makes this quick to fill out (redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx).
2) Security/compliance: who should we engage for a short 30–45 minute security walkthrough (SOC2 / data handling / KMS questions)?
3) Procurement/legal: any standard SOW/PO flow or required contract terms we should be aware of?
4) Mutual action plan: I’ll draft a MAP once we have the stakeholders and proposed timeline.

Proposed immediate step: if you can share the org chart or names for the roles above, Rishi (copied) and I will set up a focused sync with security/procurement next week.

Attachments: redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx (stakeholder mapping template)

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Anika Shah <anika@cedarpharma.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@cedarpharma.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the template — super helpful. Per your asks:

Quick stakeholder list (high level) — happy to intro where useful:
- Economic buyer: Daniel Park, VP Engineering (daniel.park@cedarpharma.com) — final budget sign-off.
- R&D product owner: Tom Nguyen (tom.nguyen@cedarpharma.com) — will own the evaluation and technical acceptance criteria.
- Security: Lila Ramos, Head of InfoSec (lila.ramos@cedarpharma.com) — prefers an initial risk questionnaire then a 30–45 min technical review.
- Legal: legal@cedarpharma.com (primary) — contract redlines handled through in-house counsel.
- Procurement: procurement@cedarpharma.com — handles PO issuance and pricing approvals.

I’ve attached a high-level org chart (cedar-org-chart.pdf) that shows reporting lines. Decision timeline: internal stakeholders are aiming for an approval/commit decision by end of Q1 2027; procurement needs budget estimates and a draft SOW to start their review.

Action items from our side:
- I’ll share the org chart (attached).
- I can intro you to Lila for a security session — she’s available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT.
- I’ll loop legal/procurement once we have a draft MAP and an initial SOW.

One request: can you share a brief MAP and a pricing ballpark to give procurement for their planning? An estimate for a 6–12 month pilot (approx 3–6 GPUs equivalent, expected token volume) is fine.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Anika Shah
Head of Product Ops | Cedar Pharma
anika@cedarpharma.com

Attachments: cedar-org-chart.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@cedarpharma.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request

Anika —

Perfect, thanks for the org chart and the quick breakdown. I’ll put together:
- Draft MAP (timeline, milestones, owner per milestone) — attached as MAP-cedar-pharma-20261104.pdf.
- Pricing ballpark for a 6-month pilot and a 12-month committed configuration (we’ll include both hosted and dedicated cost profiles).

Proposed next step: short security sync with Lila + our security lead Rishi. Rishi & Neha (copied) — are you available next Tue (11/9) 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed (11/10) 2:00–2:30 PT for a 30-min walkthrough? We’ll cover SOC2 scope, data residency, KMS options, and a lightweight threat model for the ingestion pipeline.

If that works for Cedar, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda and the draft MAP.

Thanks again — we’ll keep this tight and aligned to your Q1 decision target.

—Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
